unit.why: A list of halakhic customs (Shema pronunciation, Tachanun on a circumcision day, standing for zimun, removing tefillin at a circumcision) that R. Moshe Leib of Sasov kept, quoted from Eshel Avraham and Ateret Zvi; these are custom reports with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: closing division of the book ('תם ונשלם')
